segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Karen. I wanted to confirm the scope before I send the order form back through deal desk. I have 48 full seats, 12 read-only seats, annual term starting April 1, and the implementation package at 40 hours. Is that still right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. We may add two more full seats in finance, but not for the initial go-live. For now keep it at 48 and 12 so procurement can match the budget line.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. On pricing, the full seats are at $72 per user per month, read-only at $18, billed annually. With the services line, total year-one comes to $49,824 before tax. I’ll attach the pricing sheet so it’s easy to compare.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. The invoice needs to split software and services into separate lines. Our AP team rejects it if implementation is bundled into the subscription.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, no problem. I’ll note that in the billing tool: two line items, same PO, payment terms net 30. Do you already have the PO number or should we leave that blank for now?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Leave it blank for now. I should have the PO by Friday, March 15. Also, can you make sure the contract says auto-renewal is 30 days' notice, not 60?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, I saw that in your redlines. Legal approved the 30-day notice this morning, so the order form and the master terms will match. No other changes came back from our side.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. For go-live, we're targeting May 6. Is that still realistic if we sign by March 20?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It is. If signature is in by March 20, we can do kickoff the week of March 25, configuration in April, and user training the week of April 29. I’ll have our delivery lead hold those dates.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send the updated order form today if you can. I’ll route it to procurement and loop you in if they ask anything.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send it by 3 p.m. Eastern with the pricing sheet, the services split, and the 30-day renewal language. Thanks, Karen.
